people.name: Barak
people.line: An Israelite commander who defeated Canaanite forces with Deborah.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

people.name: Samson
people.line: Israelite judge with great strength from God

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings
